name: perm-page-survives
description: opens perm-page.html, which auto-calls navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition() on load - the exact trigger that made PermissionPromptChip dereference a null GetChipController() and SEGV the browser process (3/3 runs). Asserts the process is still alive and showing its window afterward, then that Cmd+Q can still quit it cleanly.

actions.note: let the sidebar render and the startup space's tab commit
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
commit the permission-requesting page - this is what triggered the crash
give the geolocation request, permission-prompt selection and (pre-fix) SEGV time to happen - the crash lands well within this window

assertions.desc: process still alive and showing exactly one window after the geolocation request - this is the assertion that would have failed 3/3 pre-fix
Cmd+Q actually quits (process gone) - proves the process was alive to quit
